title: NBA Champion Shaq Trolls Lakers' LeBron James, Megan The Stallion, & Asked GloRilla To Marry Him
htmlContent:
Nikola Jokic is one of the best in the NBA today, but Shaq doesn't want anyone to forget how awesome he was in his prime.

With 6-foot-11 Jokic averaging 24.7 points, 11, rebounds, and 9.2 assists per game, while shooting 61.7 percent from the field, It's hard enough to imagine anybody stopping him, even a 325-pound Shaq, but he seems to have thought about it.

“Only way he would be able to score on me is in a pick and roll situation because I’d probably have to help with Jamal Murray, which frees him up a little bit. If he’s going down in the post I don’t want no help. If he shoots a jump hook over me, good shot.” O’Neal said on Inside the NBA.

“You would have a hard time guarding him too,” Charles Barkley said.

Shaq’s response: “No I wouldn’t, not on the post. “If he’s doing those players and I gotta help out and he gets a little space where he can hit that pick and pop jumper like, the country used to eat me alive on that but not in the post, like again I would have to help on the guard, so…”

Speaking of the four-time NBA Champ, we was recently Wild N' Out in several individuals Instagram Live comments.

GloRilla : " Will you marry me”

Megan Thee Stallion: Watching that Booty

LeBron James: “Big head ass"

Finishing it off by telling someone, “I’ll give u the world... What you want baby?"
